value.summary: The change updates default model selections and adds a `reasoning_effort` flag in `src/config/defaults.toml`. No untrusted input reaches a dangerous sink, no authentication/authorization surfaces change, no new network or subprocess calls are introduced, no secrets are moved into code or logs (`api_key_env` only names an environment variable and was already present), and there are no dependency or CI permission changes. The change looks sound from a security standpoint.
